name: OpenHands
description: OpenHands is an open-source AI-driven development agent. It writes, reviews, and tests code. Important: Requires access to the Docker socket to spin up isolated execution environments. Pre-configured for local Ollama use. Detailed README (full setup & options): https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/Unraid-apps/blob/main/openhands/README.md

paths.name: Workspace Directory
paths.description: Working directory exposed to the agent

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Required so OpenHands can spawn isolated sandbox containers

variables.name: Sandbox Volumes
variables.description: Host:container mount(s) injected into every sandbox container the agent spins up. Must match the Workspace Directory mapping.

variables.name: LLM API Key
variables.description: API key for the LLM backend. For Ollama any non-empty value works (e.g. 'ollama').

variables.name: LLM Model
variables.description: LiteLLM-style model string. Default targets Ollama with qwen2.5-coder:14b.

variables.name: LLM Base URL
variables.description: Base URL of the LLM endpoint. Default reaches Ollama on the Unraid host via host.docker.internal. For a remote/LAN Ollama use http://host:11434. Leave blank for hosted providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc.) that use their own endpoints.

variables.name: LLM Embedding Model
variables.description: Embedding model used for memory/context. 'local' uses the bundled embedding model.
